name: Water model MD benchmark for protein–glycosaminoglycan complexes
description: Compares performance of different water models in molecular dynamics simulations of protein–glycosaminoglycan complexes, judging structural and dynamical metrics.
evaluation_method: simulation and structural/dynamical metrics (RMSD, radial distribution functions, hydrogen-bond statistics, diffusion coefficients, residence times)
general_score_metric: RMSD and deviations in dynamical properties (e.g., diffusion coefficients) against reference data
reputation: A niche benchmark used in computational chemistry/biophysics for assessing water models in MD simulations of glycosaminoglycan–protein systems; modest adoption within that specialist community.
notes: Non-ML benchmark requiring substantial compute; results depend strongly on simulation length, system preparation, force field choices, and statistical sampling. Dataset of complexes may be small and system-dependent, limiting broad generalization.
